title: Cover contract through the BIA near White Sands
place_text: sovereign nation near White Sands Missile Range, New Mexico

tellings.quote: we had a a cover contract through the BIA, which is the Bureau of Indian Affairs at a sovereign nation close to White Sands uh missile range in New Mexico.

plain: Jake Barber, a former military helicopter pilot who says he helped retrieve a UFO, told podcast host Jesse Michels that his team, sometime after 2001, worked under a cover contract, meaning an official-looking job that hid the real work. He says the contract ran through the Bureau of Indian Affairs, the US agency that deals with Native American tribes, at a sovereign tribal nation near White Sands Missile Range, a military testing ground in New Mexico.
